hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects configurable swap fees (30–500 bps) by intercepting swap amounts via before/after swap deltas, routing proceeds to creator, buyback/burn, rewards distributor, and platform wallets. Features a 60-second antisniper window (30% fee) at launch and locks LP so only a designated auto-LP seeder can add liquidity; removals are permanently blocked.
